dict.string: FreeFlow needs accessibility access to detect the text cursor position and paste transcribed text.
Rio Dictate controls Messages, Notes, Mail, Finder and System Events only when you ask, for example to send a text you confirmed, switch dark mode or empty the Trash.
Rio Dictate turns Bluetooth on or off when you ask it to.
Rio Dictate reads your calendar when you ask what's next or to join a meeting, and adds events when you ask. Nothing leaves your Mac.

Rio Dictate looks up the person you name (for example "text Ali") in your Contacts on this Mac to find their number. Contacts are never uploaded or stored.
FreeFlow needs microphone access to transcribe your speech.
Rio Dictate adds reminders when you ask, for example "remind me to call Mom at 3".
Rio Dictate adds reminders when you ask, for example "remind me to call Mom at 3".

Rio Dictate uses speech recognition to turn your voice into text, and for on-device listening for "Rio" in conversation mode. Conversation mode listening happens on your Mac and never leaves it, unless you turn on Arabic commands in conversation mode in Settings, which sends the audio of one command to your transcription provider.
